entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4659023090689530112 (Gaia Collaboration 2023, A&A 674, A1), ICRS at epoch J2016.0, from the archived row src/objects/hv-6093/source/photometry/gaia-dr3-source.csv. Distance: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 6093: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 47300.7 +/- 4795.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 47300.7 +/- 4795.1 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax -0.0139 +/- 0.0199 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96), -0.7 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 1.528, 0.959 mas/yr. Radial velocity: No catalogued radial velocity: Gaia DR3 measures none for source 4659023090689530112 and SIMBAD lists none. Zero is assumed; a 30 km/s error moves the star by one part in 20,000,000 of its distance per century (https://simbad.cds.unistra.fr/simbad/sim-id?Ident=Gaia%20DR3%204659023090689530112).

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 37.2 +/- 3.7 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, HV 6093: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 37.2 +/- 3.7 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 25,880,040 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5750 +/- 125 K from Groenewegen & Lub (2023), A&A 676, A136, VizieR J/A+A/676/A136/table1, Name=LMC3320, columns Teffp, e_Teffp: Teff 5750 +/- 125 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.07559). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.

entries.subject: Light curve
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 vari_cepheid, source 4659023090689530112: 5 G-band harmonics of a 4.784805979584535 d period, peak-to-peak 0.723 mag; the harmonics reproduce the row's epoch of maximum and peak-to-peak amplitude. The page plays it as a veil over the disc from the scene date, phase known to 0.01 of a cycle there.
